figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the experimental setup. The CBraMod backbone is retained with its original transformer blocks, while the positional encoding module is replaced with three primary variants under investigation: asymmetric conditional PE, Spherical PE, and learnable PE. Additionally, we extend SPE with a projection module and include a no positional encoding baseline.
